claims.text: Kasten supports GSB for storage systems with no CSI drivers
Kasten does not recommend GSB for storage without CSI drivers
Most NFS storage services do not provide a CSI driver with snapshot and clone capabilities
Kasten recommends migrating persistent data from NFS to storage with a snapshot/clone-capable CSI driver
Recommends existing customers migrate to a CSI driver with snapshot and clone capabilities
Kasten requires a CSI driver with Volume Snapshot support

A.notes: Citations [2]/[4] point to the Multi-Cluster best-practices section, which says nothing about GSB; GSB file-copy mechanism not described.

claims.text: Kasten creates snapshots of apps on Kubernetes PVs and exports to storage locations such as Veeam repositories, with a primary location like object storage or NFS
Helm options include genericStorageBackup.token, Generic Volume Snapshot restore pod resources, and injectGenericVolumeBackupSidecar webhook with selectors

B.notes: States it cannot answer whether/how NFS without CSI is protected.

claims.text: veeamconfig schedule activefull set --jobname <job_name> --monthlyweekday Mon --weeknumber Second --months Jan,Jul
--weeknumber values First, Second, Third, Fourth or Last; --months lists months
Omitting --months creates an active full backup every month
--thisday 21 --months Jan,Jul example configures active full on day 21 of Jan and Jul
Veeam Agent for IBM AIX supports configuring active full schedule via CLI
veeamconfig configures the active full backup schedule
Monthly schedule allows specifying day of month and months

B.notes: Gives the --thisday variant, says second-Monday scheduling and the omitted-months behaviour are not covered, though its own source [1] states the every-month default.
